points.description: Hue is centred around 120 degrees (the green hue).
points.partial_credit: Half if says green hue range but gives no value or a value near but not 120.

points.description: Intensity and saturation are both set to a mid-range of around 0.5 (saturation not high/low-ish because of the blackish portion of the stem).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of intensity or saturation is given as about 0.5.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for hue about 120° and intensity and saturation both about 0.5 (moderate). Give 1 mark if only one of the two ideas is right, or if the ideas are stated vaguely or one value is missing. Give 0 for wrong hue (e.g. red or blue values) or unrelated answers. Accept similar wording and close values.
